text: The Corporate Real Estate Management Division is responsible for delivering some of the City’s largest and complex capital construction projects. The Auditor General’s 2025 Audit Work Plan included a review of Corporate Real Estate Management's oversight and management of capital projects. The focus of this audit was on Corporate Real Estate Management’s processes for reviewing capital project change orders and related documentation, as changes that occur on capital projects can result in project delays and significant cost increases. In addition, the Auditor General’s 2025 Annual Report on the Fraud and Waste Hotline highlighted an emerging fraud risk related to change orders. City Council on May 20 and 21, 2026, adopted the following: 1.
